summary: The hybrid worker now stays on the same version as your installation.

new.title: Hybrid worker checks for updates hourly
new.text: The Hybrid worker now checks for its update every hour instead of once a day. Existing workers switch by themselves after their next update; nothing to do on the server.

fixes.title: Hybrid worker no longer falls behind
fixes.text: The Hybrid worker could stay a day behind after every update. It now follows your installation's current version, and Get started shows its AD check as ok or missing again.
